title: French Pan-Seared Padron Peppers
description: A simple yet flavorful French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared padron peppers. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Padron peppers to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Padron peppers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
